title: Photo 179 · 애슬리트 USSBBW · 알레브리헤 · 비스듬히 기대앉기 · 남아시아 40대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a horizontal landscape-orientation photograph, 3:2 aspect ratio, wider than it is tall.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing in the frame but a low flat platform with a plain padded backrest at one end, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult South Asian woman in her late 40s, faint lines at the eyes and mouth, rich warm brown skin tone with golden undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a short cropped pixie cut, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears long chain earrings and has rounded nails with a deep gloss.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so long and vast that her head and her feet are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. The body of a world's strongest woman pushed far past real limits: enormously broad thick shoulders, massive heavy arms so thick they cannot hang flat against her sides, a colossal bust, a huge barrel torso, no waist at all. On her middle. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and spills forward down the slope of her own raised torso under its own weight, piling up over the tops of her thighs and reaching toward her knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds stacked one in front of the other, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Colossal wide hips and a huge rounded powerful rear, tree-trunk thighs pressing together down to the knees, thick heavy calves. Immense power under a thick layer of soft fat: the muscle is huge but rounded and buried, only broad blunt swells at the shoulders, upper arms and thighs, no sharp muscle separation anywhere, no carved abs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body and her hands look small against her thighs. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The flesh is softer and looser at this age, each fold hanging lower and settling further over the one below it. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how it spills forward down her body, settles and presses flat against the platform beneath her.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a coarser surface grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, crepey texture in the deepest folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Oaxacan alebrije style — her own skin tone as the base colour, densely painted with vivid neon magenta, yellow, lime green, turquoise and orange dots, stripes, zigzags and small flowers, a bright striped band following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs, no animal figures. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Reclining on the platform propped up against the backrest at about 45 degrees, her legs stretched out straight in front of her and slightly apart, her arms resting back on the platform behind her hips with the elbows out so nothing crosses in front of her torso, her head turned toward the camera, her colossal hips and rear spreading wide and flattening against the platform, her body stretching across the full width of the frame from edge to edge.

Footwear: Extreme magenta platform stiletto sandals with toe rings, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the neon colours blazing, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Horizontal 3:2 landscape-orientation full-body photograph, wider than it is tall.
